independence: No collapse-gap, gap-repair, V6/V7, or below-gap event identity is used.
economic_hypothesis: A Main-Board or ChiNext sleeve can sustain a bull phase even when whole-market breadth is not extreme. Inside a healthy industry, a stock with a positive but bounded medium trend that builds a rising-floor, shrinking-turnover base below a previously traded pressure level has absorbed nearby supply. A first high-location close through that pressure level on renewed turnover is tradable only when the historical turnover-decayed inventory in the symmetric 15% corridor above the level is small relative to the 15% corridor below it.

binding_conditions.PIT_BOARD_PHASE_AND_INDUSTRY_DEMAND: same-sleeve board60>3%, board breadth60>=55%, board120>0, board breadth120>=50%, board20>-5%, board breadth20>=40%; PIT industry n>=5, industry60>0, breadth60>=55%, industry20>0, breadth20>=55%
binding_conditions.BOUNDED_TREND_AND_RISING_FLOOR_BASE: prior completed 60-session return in [5%,60%], completed signal ret120>0, prior20 pressure / prior10 floor - 1 <=20%, prior10 range<=15%, and prior10 floor>=prior11-20 floor
binding_conditions.SUPPLY_CONTRACTION_AND_FIRST_PRESSURE_RE: prior10 mean turnover / prior11-40 mean turnover<=0.85; frozen prior21-120 high is between -3% and +20% of prior20 pressure; previous close below prior20 pressure; completed signal close at/above pressure; signal return [2%,7%], close location>=70%, signal turnover 1.3x to 5x prior20 mean
binding_conditions.LOW_DECAYED_OVERHEAD: using only prior 120 completed valid same-lineage sessions, typical coordinate price=(high+low+close)/3 and mass=turnover_fraction*exp(-subsequent completed cumulative turnover); at least 10 historical observations in [0.85P,P); decayed mass in [P,1.15P] divided by total decayed mass in [0.85P,1.15P] <=20%

feature_clock: completed signal-session close; all stock history used by base and inventory excludes the signal session; board and PIT industry state use the completed signal session
entry: first legal daily open strictly after signal, within three exchange sessions

T15_H10_X1.failure: completed close below frozen prior10 floor, then next legal open

T15_H12_X1.failure: completed close below frozen prior10 floor, then next legal open

T20_H10_X1.failure: completed close below frozen prior10 floor, then next legal open

T20_H12_X1.failure: completed close below frozen prior10 floor, then next legal open

profile_selection: Among Development-gate-qualified profiles, maximize median active-year mean net, then pooled mean net, then lower severe_loss10, then shorter mean holding, then X0 over X1, then lower target.
